CBSA population, 2000-2025

Source: R/population-data.R
pop_cbsa.Rd

Annual population for core-based statistical areas (metropolitan and micropolitan), computed by summing pop_county over the counties in each CBSA under the 2023 delineation, so every year uses the same boundaries.

Usage

pop_cbsa

Format

A data frame with one row per CBSA and year:

CBSA_FIPS

Five-digit CBSA code

CBSA_NAME

CBSA title

YEAR

Year

POP

Population

Source

U.S. Census Bureau; see pop_county.

See also

cbsa_county_xwalk, npc_get_population()
